target_customer: Sales and business professionals who take many meetings
problem: Notetaking and CRM data entry after meetings is manual; Sonnet transcribed meetings, wrote notes and auto-updated a built-in CRM.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free tier
product_category: Meeting assistant and CRM, generative AI

founders.name: Dylan Feng
founders.background_notes: YC page says he graduated in two years and did research at BAIR.

technical_complexity.rationale: Transcription and summarization with LLMs plus CRM sync; bot-free audio capture was harder.

defensibility.rationale: Many notetakers and models available to everyone.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Notetaking became a crowded category; sources found do not say who copied Sonnet.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Anthropic's later Claude Sonnet models, hurting search; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Sonnet as Inactive, but sonnetai.com is live with a Windows app and a free tier, and Product Hunt shows a 2024 launch, so the status conflicts and no cause of failure is public. The notetaker category was crowded and a name clash with a major AI model may have hurt discoverability.
notes: The 500K pre-seed rests on a single aggregator (Bouncewatch, dated 22 August 2022); other aggregators say 20K or 520K. A directory also lists Techstars, unreliable. Exit type unknown because the site appears active. Founded year unknown. No competitors with dated sources found; YC page names only generic meeting bots. Founder bios are from the YC page.
